explanation: The patch propagates destination buffers as std::span objects and bounds both direct-child copies with the destination span. However, the out-of-line CharBuffer allocation is one element short while the returned span advertises the requested length. Internalizing a 256-character cons string therefore writes one element past the allocation. The upstream fix allocates the exact requested length.

verification.build: gn gen out/x64.asan >/dev/null && ninja -j8 -C out/x64.asan d8
verification.edited_tree: out/x64.asan/d8 --allow-natives-syntax pocs/probe.js exits 1 with AddressSanitizer heap-buffer-overflow: WRITE of size 1 after a 255-byte region
verification.real_fix: After applying golden.diff and rebuilding, the same command exits 0 with no AddressSanitizer error or fatal signal
